38. 某数列的第 n 项为 2n−19。下列何者正确？
I. 25 为该数列的其中一项。
II. 该数列有 10 个负值项。
III. 该数列的前 n 项之和为 n^2−18n。

A. 只有 I
B. 只有 II
C. 只有 I 及 III
D. 只有 II 及 III
reasoning: Statement I is true because solving 2n−19=25 gives n=22, an integer term. Statement II is false: the terms are negative for n=1 to 9, which are 9 terms, not 10. Statement III is true as the sum S_n = Σ_{k=1}^n (2k−19) = n^2−18n. Hence only statements I and III are correct, which corresponds to option C.
